properties.name: Kofinou Centralized Utility BESS Hub
properties.subtype: Grid-Scale Centralized Battery Energy Storage System
properties.description: Cyprus's premier utility-scale centralized battery storage system awarded under CERA's fast-track scheme. Provides rapid synthetic inertia, primary frequency containment reserves (FCR), and absorbs midday solar curtailment for evening peak injection.

properties.name: Vasilikos Industrial BESS & Frequency Anchor
properties.operator: Electricity Authority of Cyprus (EAC) / Private IPP
properties.description: High-voltage grid firming installation adjacent to the Vasilikos generation complex. Designed to supply automatic secondary frequency restoration (aFRR) and black-start backup.

properties.name: Dhekelia Hybrid Transition Storage Project
properties.subtype: Thermal Power Plant Hybrid Storage Conversion
properties.description: Part of the green transition roadmap for the Dhekelia site. Replaces spinning reserve from aging fuel-oil combustion engines with instantaneous battery response.

properties.name: Geri Co-Located Solar + Storage Project
properties.chemistry: LFP Battery Racks with Bi-directional Inverters
properties.description: Co-located directly alongside the 45 MWp Geri solar farm. Eliminates renewable energy curtailment during peak midday solar generation hours by storing excess solar megawatts for evening discharge.
